title: SUM (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT '$' || SUM(Salary) AS Total_Payroll FROM Sample.Employee
SELECT Title, '$' || SUM(Salary) AS Total, '$' || AVG(Salary) AS Average FROM Sample.Employee GROUP BY Title ORDER BY Average
SELECT Title, '$' || SUM(Salary) AS BeforeRaises, '$' || SUM(Salary * 1.1) AS AfterRaises FROM Sample.Employee GROUP BY Title ORDER BY Title
SELECT COUNT(Salary) As AllPaid, SUM(CASE WHEN (Salary >= 90000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) As TopPaid FROM Sample.Employee
SELECT Home_State, '$' || SUM(Salary) AS Total_Payroll, '$' || SUM(Salary %AFTERHAVING) AS Exec_Payroll FROM Sample.Employee GROUP BY Home_State HAVING Salary > 80000 ORDER BY Home_State
